mil7.2.8:1.1: Bhante Nāgasena, cāpassa ekaṃ angaṃ gahetabban ti yaṃ vedesi, kataman-taṃ ekaṃ angaṃ gahetabban-ti. - Yathā mahārāja cāpo sutacchito mito yāv' aggamūlaṃ samakam-eva anunamati na paṭitthambhati, evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena thera-nava-majjhimasamakesu anunamitabbaṃ na paṭippharitabbaṃ. Idaṃ mahārāja cāpassa ekaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ. Bhāsitam-p' etaṃ mahārāja Bhagavatā devātidevena Vidhura-Puṇṇakajātake:
mil7.2.8:2.1: Cāpo vānuname dhīro, vaṃso va anulomayaṃ paṭilomaṃ na vatteyya, sa rājavasatiṃ vase ti.
